ways.label: Toaroha roadend to Whitcombe road end via Toaroha and Frew saddles

start.name: Toaroha Valley road end car park

evidence: From the car park follow the rough farm road down to river level, then pick up the orange triangular markers and follow these across the open flats to the bush line and the start of the track.
Cross this and follow the benched track, dropping to the Hokitika riverbed some 600 m from the road end.
From the road end there is approximately 5 km of rough farm road to follow before the Hokitika Gorge Road is reached.
Alternatively access can be gained from the Whitcombe Valley Road (Hokitika Gorge Road) and the route walked in the reverse order to that described.

doubts: Start: the text says only 'car park'/'Roadend' reached from the Kokatahi/Lake Kaniere road over the Kokatahi River; F2 (track meets Middlebranch Road) is the only road-end feature on the Toaroha side, but the text does not name that road. End: the Whitcombe-side road end (5 km of farm road from Hokitika Gorge Road) has no matching feature. F1 is labelled a road end but is where a track meets Cedar Flat Bridge, which the text says is crossed to the huts; used as a via. The route does not go over the true Toaroha Saddle (T20) but a low saddle to the west. Route can be walked in reverse from Whitcombe Valley Road.
